title: Change Radius: blind spots stay visible
audience: Reviewers who need bounded consumer and test navigation without a misleading universal blast-radius score.
promise: Start from one changed symbol, follow provider-named static consumers and tests, and keep dynamic, generated, reflective, and external boundaries explicit.
story: A TypeScript seed symbol gives the analysis a concrete file and name.
Static imports produce provider-named consumer edges, including a test edge.
A dynamic import is reported as an unknown rather than promoted to a known edge.
The receipt carries the target revision, limitations, and next review action.
verified_locally: Real TypeScript fixture with two static edges and one test edge.
Dynamic-import unknown boundary preserved in the receipt.
Target-bound receipt records provider, limitations, and next action.
Current dev tests, lint, and package checks pass at revision a849c8a.
The 1600×900 PNG preview is visually reviewed and legible at the target crop.
open_gates: Connect the same symbol and unknown classes to Deletion Proof and Contract Watch.
Add generated, reflective, external, and negative fixture receipts.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves the current dev bounded static TypeScript graph slice and local binary preview; it does not claim complete runtime use, downstream parity, a universal blast radius, or publication.
